objective: Build a new signed staging-user APK from latest V30 production main with canonical green-B launcher branding (not previous multicolor Android icon). Source must be latest main, not any historical staging branch.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified latest main da2ddfd8d5942865707ad6f308ff074fca73e99b (merged V30 AAB config), prior successful staging APK run 42486145405 was built from older main ce157c66 and displayed legacy multicolor icon; the canonical green-B web logo is assets/release/buklod-main-canonical.png blob 9a4e4a826191d6e310dc26f5c74d4611293ceb17. Previous PR #527 retired web legacy icon but intentionally left Android icon unchanged. New consolidated UI release main da2ddfd8d5942865707ad6f308ff074fca73e99b is the exact fresh source pin; includes PR #587 layout/reaction/photo/music fixes.
chosenApproach: Change only staging appConfig icon/adaptiveIcon to canonical green-B and align staging versionName to V30 main 1.3.6, preserve production Android icon and ABI/runtime 1.3.2. Pin staging artifact source ancestry to current main V30 sha and verify canonical asset blob SHA, Expo preflight, EAS finished APK and source SHA. Build one EAS staging-user internal signed APK via explicitly labeled merge; no OTA/web/Google Play.
preserveBehaviors: Production Android icon and native compatibility contract unchanged
Main app features/assets and source pin remain current production main
Staging Firebase/preview channel package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging and runtime1.3.2 unchanged
No production OTA/web/Play changes; no unmerged dev branch included
acceptanceChecks: Diff app source from da2ddfd8d5942865707ad6f308ff074fca73e99b includes only exact staged icon and versionName mapping
Canonical green-B asset is the pinned existing PNG from main
Code/type contracts, staging Firebase and Expo preview environment pass before build
Signed EAS staging-user APK finished with source SHA, correct URL/version and internal distribution
Obsolete branches must not supply source; branch deletion requires separate non-destructive audit
selectionRationale: The owner needs a dependable stage APK from the exact newest main with the approved green-B launcher. Restricting the asset change to the stage environment avoids production V28/V30 native config/OTA ABI drift while ensuring tests exercise the new release screen and app source.
alternativeApproaches: Re-run last successfully signed stage APK (ce157c66): rejected due stale source and verified legacy launcher icon.
Build an APK from one of 14 older staging branches: rejected because they diverge from latest production main and can regress features.
Switch production Android icon in this PR: rejected because it alters protected production native config and unrelated V30 AAB/OTA release artifacts.
